description: Verify signed evidence produced by Insight or by an agent: a pre-trade/execution pair, a Base agent-swap settlement, a Solana swap settlement, or one Hyperliquid order/fill record. Use it when a third party needs to check binding and signatures before trusting a claim. Do not use it to re-assess oracle risk or to authorize trading. Returns valid/invalid, the closed-loop or settlement status, binding assertions and machine-readable reasons. Deprecated alias: prefer trade_proof with op "verify_evidence". Removed on 2027-01-06.
name: verify_evidence
